subject: Mechanical Engineering
title: Bearing Failure Modes: How Bearings Die
description: A fast breakdown of Bearing Failure Modes: How Bearings Die for builders.

hook.text: Bearings don't just stop. They fail in specific, predictable ways.

buildup.text: Fatigue spalling creates tiny craters as cracks grow under cyclic stress.

discovery.text: Contamination, corrosion, and misalignment each leave distinct damage marks.

twist.text: Over 90% of bearings die before predicted life from preventable causes.

climax.text: Reading the failure pattern tells engineers exactly what went wrong.

punchline.text: Dead bearings always leave a confession if you look.

quiz.question: What is fatigue spalling in a bearing?
options: The bearing overheats and welds to the shaft
Cracks grow under the raceway, breaking off small craters
Lubricant dries and the bearing seizes from friction
